raw.rationale: Bisoprolol is a peripherally acting beta-1-selective adrenergic antagonist with no known broad cytotoxic or lineage-selective anticancer activity at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-agent screens of similar launched cardiovascular drugs rarely show lineage-selective killing beyond base rates. Thus probabilities are near the low base-rate range for all lineages, with only minor variation for lineages where ADRB2 signaling or adrenergic biology has been reported (e.g., breast, melanoma/skin).
